disclaimer.privacy: Illustrative text for the Nirby project. Replace with a reviewed, compliant policy before any real public launch.
disclaimer.mentions: Under article 6 of French law no. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004, the notice below is an example for this project. Substitute accurate information before public release.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy of the Nirby service (sample content)
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: RNCP demonstration project “Nirby” (fictitious publisher: Société Exemple SARL), fictitious registered office: 12 rue du Parchemin, 75000 Paris, France.
privacy.s2Body: Account data (identifier, email address, hashed password, profile), content you create (lists, places, optional media), technical data required to run the service (sessions, limited logs), and interactions with third-party processors used by the demo (email delivery, maps, place search).
privacy.s3Body: Providing the Nirby service, authentication, security, support, and qualitative product improvement within this educational project.
privacy.s4Body: Performance of pre-contractual steps and of the user agreement; legitimate interest for security and abuse prevention, in line with proportionality (generic wording — to be refined for a real processing activity).
privacy.s5Body: Account data is kept until the account is deleted. Verification or password-reset tokens: a few hours up to twenty-four hours depending on the case. Other periods are described in the project’s technical documentation.
privacy.s6Body: In this demonstration project: PostgreSQL (PostGIS) and Redis for data, S3 object storage, email delivery via Resend, Mapbox mapping and Google Places search. Publisher and commercial host names remain fictitious.
privacy.s7Body: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection where provided by the GDPR, and a complaint to the CNIL (<cnil>cnil.fr</cnil>). To exercise your rights: use the contact in section 1.
privacy.s8Body: Technical measures described in the project report (authentication, input validation, development practices). Details: “Technical specifications — security”.
privacy.s9Body: Nirby uses strictly necessary cookies to run the service. Optional error monitoring is loaded only with your consent. You can change this choice at any time from your profile (Privacy).
privacy.s9Necessary: Strictly necessary (no prior consent): the httpOnly refreshToken cookie (authentication, SameSite=strict); the NEXT_LOCALE cookie (language preference, 1 year, SameSite=lax). Display theme is stored in localStorage (next-themes) and is not a tracker.
privacy.s9Mapbox: Mapbox GL loads map tiles required for the product. It is not gated by the consent banner: refusing it would break the map. Google Places is called only through the Nirby API; the browser does not set a Google cookie for place search.
privacy.s9Sentry: Optional: the Sentry client SDK (error telemetry). It is initialised only if you accept it in the cookie banner. Server-side Sentry does not set a browser cookie.
